errors.text_span: При MoE слой 23 виждаме, че Expert 1 заема около 15%, Expert 2 около 10%, Expert 3 около 25% и Expert 4 около 50%.
errors.evidence: This description of the values for MoE layer 23 does not match either of the two charts. In the 'Text' chart, layer 23 is composed of Expert 2 (~15%) and Expert 3 (~85%). In the 'Image' chart, layer 23 is composed of Expert 1 (~85%), Expert 2 (~10%), and Expert 3 (~5%). The reported values are completely incorrect.

errors.evidence: This statement claims that Expert 4 (red) makes up the largest part of each column. This is incorrect.
